description: Fixed prompt set for EdgeQ-SLM benchmarking experiments

categories.factual: Factual Q&A prompts requiring knowledge retrieval
categories.edge: Edge case prompts for stress testing

prompts.text: What is the capital of France?
How many planets are in our solar system?
Explain what photosynthesis is and why it is important for life on Earth.
What are the main differences between RAM and ROM in computers?
Describe the process of how vaccines work in the human body, including the role of antibodies and memory cells in providing immunity against diseases.
List 5 fruits that are red in color.
Translate 'Hello, how are you?' to Spanish.
Write a Python function that calculates the factorial of a number. Include a docstring explaining what the function does.
Create a bullet-point summary of the benefits and drawbacks of remote work. Include at least 3 points for each.
Write a step-by-step tutorial for beginners explaining how to set up a basic HTML webpage with CSS styling. Include example code for each step and explain what each part does.
Write a haiku about autumn leaves.
Create a catchy slogan for an eco-friendly water bottle company.
Write a short dialogue between a curious child and a wise old tree. The child asks about the meaning of life.
Describe a futuristic city in the year 2150 where humans and AI coexist harmoniously. Focus on daily life.

Write the opening paragraph of a mystery novel. Set the scene in a small coastal town on a foggy morning. Introduce a detective who has just arrived to investigate a disappearance. Create atmosphere and intrigue.

You are an expert in mobile application development and machine learning optimization. I am working on a thesis project that involves running a Small Language Model (SLM) on mobile devices. The model is quantized using INT8 quantization and runs through llama.cpp. I need you to analyze the following scenario and provide detailed recommendations: 1. What are the key performance bottlenecks when running transformer models on ARM64 mobile CPUs? 2. How does INT8 quantization affect model quality versus speed tradeoffs? 3. What memory optimization techniques should I consider for devices with limited RAM (4-6GB)? 4. How can I measure and report performance metrics in an academically rigorous way? 5. What are the limitations of on-device inference that I should acknowledge in my thesis? Please provide a comprehensive response covering all these points with specific technical details.
